   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: Jul 10, 2026 - Oct 14, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _KC Mentzer_, Oct 14, 2026, 1/5: "I absolutely hate the new Planet Fitness app update. When I check in, I don’t need an animation telling me to have a good workout. Just let me skip it and move on! I want to check in my guests without having to deal with unnecessary screens or issues. The old process was much simpler. Please make check-in quick, easy, and user-friendly again!"
            2. _AJey Calloway_, Jul 18, 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined planet fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter planet fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
            3. _Zachary Bohannon_, Jul 13, 2026, 1/5: "awful designed app i literally cannot log in to the app it's so broken"
